measured baselines: this environment could not run `cargo build` /
`stellar contract optimize` to capture real current sizes when this
budget file was first introduced (see the PR that added this file for
why). Tighten each budget to roughly current-size-plus-headroom after
the first real CI run reports actual numbers — that tightening is a
follow-up, not a blocker for this file existing and being enforced.
